line: Crowley's Seven of Cups is the card for the third decan of Scorpio, with Venus as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Scorpio.

quotes.quote: The Seven of Cups is called Debauch.
the card is governed by Venus in Scorpio

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card refers to the Seven, Netzach, in the suit of Water.
